description: A credit card validator for the format: the network, the length and the Luhn check digit. Nothing is sent. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

number.description: The card number whose format to check, e.g. '4111 1111 1111 1111' (a published Visa test number). Spaces, hyphens and dots are ignored. Only the format is checked: the network from the leading digits, the length that network issues and the Luhn check digit. It cannot tell whether a card exists, is active or has funds. The number is checked in memory and is not stored or logged; use a test number.

name: credit_card_validator
title: Credit Card Validator
